name: Eldoria
description: A vast and ancient world shaped by magic, war, and the ambitions of its people.
creation_myth: It is said the world was sung into existence by the goddess Elyra, whose voice became the wind and rivers.
history: The Age of Dawn: The first civilizations rose along the Silver River.
The Dragon Wars: Kingdoms united to drive back the dragon overlords.
The Shattering: The world was divided into countries after the fall of the Old Empire.
current_events: Trade routes between Eldoria and Valtara are threatened by bandit activity.
A mysterious plague has appeared in the southern lands.
The Silver Blades guild has gained fame for their recent exploits.

notable_figures.name: Queen Mirabel
notable_figures.description: A wise and just queen, beloved by her people.

notable_figures.name: Archmage Thalos
notable_figures.description: Keeper of magical secrets and advisor to rulers.

legends: The Lost City of Gold is said to lie beneath the Great Desert.
A prophecy foretells the return of the dragon overlords.
clan_achievements: The Silver Blades defeated the dragon of Buglia.
The Crimson Brotherhood brokered peace between Eldoria and Myrr.
